source: Existing GruhaPravesha panchanga-suitability.json plus Verified HoraLife Research
notes: Hard exclusions use the existing Gruha Pravesha avoid lists. Kalasha ranges and prohibited lagnas come from the verified HoraLife research supplied for this profile. Amanta and Purnimanta are accepted as a request label only. Lunar month boundaries are not calculated.

kalasha.notes: Inclusive nakshatra count from Sun nakshatra to Moon nakshatra. These ranges are profile metadata, not hard-coded business constants.

vrisha.notes: TODO: Vrisha Chakra formula is not verified in project metadata. The evaluator stays disabled and does not reject.

lagna.notes: Prohibited lagnas are configurable. They require validation against a reference Panchanga before being treated as universal.

knownGaps: Amanta/Purnimanta lunar month boundaries are not calculated. The calendar system is stored and returned.
Dur Muhurta, Varjyam, and Gandanta have no formula in this repository and stay disabled.
Panchaka has no verified Graha Pravesha action. The placeholder stays disabled and does not reject.
Vrisha Chakra stays disabled until a verified formula exists.
No verified standalone vara quality list. Every weekday is acceptable unless a future profile says otherwise.
Planetary yogas beyond Tara Bala, Chandra Bala, and houses 4, 8, and 11 are not invented.
